top.text: Yes, it sells game bundles: several games for one price, and part of the money goes to charity. Check what's in a bundle first so you only pay for games you would actually play.
Co-op games are a great pick for this. It Takes Two is built for exactly two players, and Overcooked 2 is chaotic fun for any age mix. Looking forward to the art!
Good pick for a sci-fi horror mood. The System Shock remake lets you set difficulty separately for combat, puzzles and cyberspace, so it's easier to tune than its reputation suggests.
A new laptop plus an indie backlog sounds like a great combo. Indie games are often easy on modest hardware, and the system requirements on each Steam page tell you before you buy.
SimTower and Sim Safari are real deep cuts. Bundles like that were a great way to stumble onto odd little Maxis games.
